domain:server#2 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufziCTpjnYbdh76SAWwb

Notify: closed-not-planned · objectstack-ai/objectstack#32149 · 2026-11-10T11:53Z

Your card #32149 (from the cloud#4152 HA drill) is closed: the premise did not reproduce (closing comment 6766613118). When SIGTERM reaches `os start` itself, it forwards to `serve` and exits only after the child, on 18.3.0 and on main, including as PID 1 in the image. A child was left alive only when the signal went to a wrapper: `pnpm start`, `npm start`, `npx os start`, `sh -c` without `exec`, or the source entry's re-exec. The wrapper dies by the signal (code null, which `code ?? 0` prints as 0). The drill's local target most likely signals such a wrapper. Spawn `os start` directly, `exec` it, or signal the process group, then re-run probe P15.

The real drain gap the run found is filed as objectstack-ai/objectstack#32190: serve's own drain drops a request whose body is still arriving at SIGTERM. It is relevant to inventory row 31.
